name: Scogger
author: Scognito
description_short: Arcade-style frog-jumping game where you cross tree trunks.
description_long: Scogger is an arcade-style puzzle game where you guide a frog across tree trunks. Each playthrough selects ten levels at random from a pool of one hundred. The frog can jump forward, left, and right, but never backward. Clear each stage to advance to the next level.

license.notes: The original release and its GitHub mirror do not include a license declaration.
